messages:
harry: FYI push to staging (gcr/myservice:v2) blocked by deploy-bot. Reject: provenance attestation mismatch — key id differs between regions. Anyone on-call for signing/keys?

deploy-bot: publish_rejected: reason=[provenance.attestation_mismatch, cosign_key_allowlist_fail]. details: https://deploybot.internal/rejects/4390011122

ivy: we rotated the EU cosign key last week. Could be the rotation didn't propagate to the keys-service allowlist used by deploy-bot in us-west.

jack: replication might be delayed. Can someone run `gcloud artifacts docker images describe gcr.io/redwood/myservice:v2` and `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=cosign-eu` to check which key signed the EU copy?

ivy: checking... EU key version created 2026-02-28T09:03Z, signature on EU artifact references key `projects/redwood/locations/europe/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/cosign-eu/cryptoKeyVersions/3`. Deploy-bot allowlist only has versions 1..2.

kate: ops note: keys-service changes require audit + migration window. I can add v3 to allowlist for staging only, but we need documented approval and a rollback plan. Change window in 30m so quick decision.

louis: SRE preference: do not open prod to new key today. Steps: 1) rollback staging canary to previous digest, 2) add key v3 to staging allowlist, 3) re-sign EU pushes with v3 and verify, 4) after 24h stability, schedule prod key update.

harry: ok. Initiating rollback to previous digest sha256:cccccccc... to keep canary healthy.

deploy-bot: rollback executed by harry — staging/canary now points to sha256:cccccccc.... awaiting health checks.

ivy: filing INFRA-6001: keys-service allowlist sync failure for cosign-eu, will patch to include v3 for staging and trigger redeploy of deploy-bot config.

jack: reminder: images signed with the old key won't validate against v3; we'll need to re-sign EU-built images with v3. That means a rebuild/resign in EU region.

kate: I'll open a quick change CHG-2026-0301 to add v3 to staging allowlist with security approval. Preparing the justification now.

harry: triggering EU resign job: `CI_REGION=eu ./ci/sign-and-push.sh --key=cosign-eu:v3`. Notifying when done.

ivy: resign job finished; signature id sha256:dddddddd... uploaded to EU registry.

deploy-bot: publish_check: verifying new signature for gcr.io/redwood/myservice:v2 (eu). Result: ok for staging, replication checks pending.

louis: putting a 1hr hold on cross-region promotion/ramping for this image. We'll not touch prod until tomorrow maintenance window.

kate: security approved CHG-2026-0301 for staging allowlist update (audit ticket recorded). Will coordinate the infra rollback if anything goes wrong.

harry: release notes update: "staging push blocked due to cosign key rotation mismatch across regions; rolled back canary; added new EU key to staging allowlist; re-signed EU images; hold on prod promotion until scheduled maintenance."

ivy: INFRA-6001 created with action items: keys-service reconciliation job, deploy-bot allowlist auto-sync, and postmortem due.

louis: thanks team. If replication verification passes in 20m we can resume normal canary ramp in staging. If not, escalate to incident-channel for a cross-region rollback plan.
